問い: 分析名が「空腹時血糖」の検査の、分析結果の値
aqls:
SELECT o/data[at0001]/events[at0002]/data[at0003]/items[openEHR-EHR-CLUSTER.laboratory_test_analyte.v1]/items[at0024]/value/value, o/data[at0001]/events[at0002]/data[at0003]/items[openEHR-EHR-CLUSTER.laboratory_test_analyte.v1]/items[at0001]/value/magnitude
FROM EHR e CONTAINS COMPOSITION c CONTAINS OBSERVATION o[openEHR-EHR-OBSERVATION.laboratory_test_result.v1]
WHERE o/data[at0001]/events[at0002]/data[at0003]/items[openEHR-EHR-CLUSTER.laboratory_test_analyte.v1]/items[at0024]/value/value = "空腹時血糖"
